senses.gloss:
केकय केकय,
 I. m.
 1. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 356.
 2. Their prince, Rām. 2, 35, 21.
 II. f. यी, One of the wives of Daśaratha, Rām. 2, 70, 20.
केका केका (an imitative sound), f. The cry of the peacock, MBh. 15, 724.
केकिन् केकिन्, i. e. केका + इन्, m. A peacock, Bhartṛ. 1, 44.
